items.title: Új, Yggdrasil-hálózatban rejtőző backdoort használtak ukrán logisztikai vállalat elleni adattörlő támadásban Az ESET kutatói egy korábban nem dokumentált, MythicRatatoskr nevű backdoort azonosítottak…

items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: GitLab patched a critical flaw allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution on GitLab servers; CERT-EU urges prioritising internet-facing instances and compromise assessment.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AMP feature has a critical, actively exploited flaw allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to write files and run commands as root; patch immediately.

items.title: External Teams Chats Anchor 15-Minute Malware Delivery
items.summary: A large ongoing social engineering campaign abuses external Microsoft Teams chats to deliver malware within about 15 minutes, possibly linked to the Black Basta ransomware gang.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 27.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at's daily report covers 'Broccoli2Shell' (CVE-2026-111497), a critical Brotli decoder flaw affecting Node.js, Bun, Envoy Proxy and others, allowing unauthenticated memory corruption and data disclosure.

items.title: Dahua márkájú megfigyelőkamerák sérülékenységét használják ki a támadók Ukrajna számítógépes vészhelyzeteket kezelő csoportja, a CERT-UA a múlt hét végén olyan incidensekről számolt be, amelyek során…
items.summary: CERT-UA reported incidents in which attackers exploited a vulnerability in Dahua-branded surveillance cameras.

items.title: Italy's AI Act framework takes shape: What Legislative Decree No. 179/2026 means for organizations
items.summary: Italy's Legislative Decree No. 179/2026 implements its national AI Act framework, with practical compliance implications for organisations operating in Italy.

items.title: NIST starts the countdown to retire quantum-vulnerable encryption
items.summary: NIST released IR 8547, a roadmap for transitioning to post-quantum cryptography, setting deadlines to retire quantum-vulnerable algorithms, with earlier dates for sensitive federal systems.

items.summary: Japan's GMO Group told customers to disconnect systems and shut down PCs after an intruder in its Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to deploy ransomware.

items.title: SBOMs Alone Can't Reveal the Scope of a Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Analysis of a recent Shai-Hulud supply chain attack argues SBOMs alone are insufficient; defenders need real-time visibility into production code and affected services.

items.title: CVE-2026-35273: SSRF to RCE in Oracle PeopleSoft

items.title: Kiberbiztonsági incidens miatt irányították át a betegeket egy új-mexikói kórházból Egy kiberbiztonsági esemény hatására a University of New Mexico Health System hétfőn több, mint 30 klinikáján töröl…

items.title: Keeping pace with e-evidence: New report examines Europe’s digital forensic capabilities
